title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: Late Declaration Fee Rate and Single Charge per Submission
content:
## Clause

The late declaration fee of Dangerous Goods Acceptance is the category's full tariff amount below, charged per acceptance. A late submission bears it once at most: when the acceptance's account already holds a late declaration fee entry referring to the declaration being judged, nothing further is charged.

## Tariff (USD per acceptance)

| Category | Late declaration fee |
|---|---|
| AHL DG Limited Quantity | 150.00 |
| AHL DG Class 9 Standard | 250.00 |
| AHL DG Flammables and Corrosives | 350.00 |
| AHL DG Toxics and Oxidizers | 450.00 |
| AHL DG Compressed Gases | 450.00 |
| AHL DG Special Approval | 900.00 |

## Cases

| Category | Account already holds a late fee entry for the judged declaration | Fee now |
|---|---|---|
| AHL DG Flammables and Corrosives | no | 350.00 |
| AHL DG Flammables and Corrosives | yes | nothing further |
| AHL DG Special Approval | no | 900.00 |

## Point of judgement

**Is a late fee ever charged in part?** The charge is the category's figure in full.
